style: Strict pixel art game sprite for a cozy farming life-sim. Straight-on, front-facing top-down 3/4 view: the camera looks down at the object from the south at about 35 degrees, so we see the FRONT face and the TOP/roof, exactly like classic 16-bit farming RPGs. NOT isometric, no diagonal side walls, perfectly symmetric front-on framing. Crisp hard square pixels on a clear pixel grid, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no noise. Warm, saturated, friendly palette (about 24 colors), soft light from the top-left, a dark brown (#3a2414) 1-pixel outline around the silhouette. Isolated on a plain flat solid magenta #FF00FF background filling the rest of the frame, nothing else in the image, no ground tile, no cast shadow, no text, no border.

assets.name: farmhouse
assets.prompt: A cozy one-storey wooden farmhouse: honey-coloured horizontal plank walls, a big red shingled gable roof seen from the front, a stone chimney on the right, a green front door in the middle with a small step, two windows with warm yellow light and flower boxes with pink and red flowers.

assets.name: barn
assets.prompt: A classic red barn: red vertical plank walls with white trim, big double doors with a white X brace on each door, a hay loft window with golden hay above the doors, dark grey shingle gambrel roof seen from the front.

assets.name: coop
assets.prompt: A small wooden chicken coop: cream plank walls, a teal shingle roof, a little arched door with a wooden ramp leading up to it, one small round window, a few straw bits at the base.

assets.name: shipping_bin
assets.prompt: A wooden shipping bin crate with a hinged lid propped slightly open, filled with fresh produce: a pumpkin, carrots, a cabbage and red apples peeking out.

assets.name: notice_board
assets.prompt: A small village notice board: two wooden posts, a wooden board with a little shingle roof on top, three pinned paper notes with red and blue pins, one note marked with an exclamation mark.

assets.name: mailbox
assets.prompt: A rural mailbox: a rounded blue metal mailbox on a wooden post, with a red flag raised on the side.

assets.name: well
assets.prompt: A stone water well: round grey cobblestone base, two wooden posts holding a small red shingle roof, a crank and a wooden bucket hanging on a rope.

assets.name: scarecrow
assets.prompt: A friendly scarecrow on a wooden post: straw hat, burlap sack face with a stitched smile, blue patched shirt, straw sticking out of the sleeves.

assets.name: woodpile
assets.prompt: A neat stack of split firewood logs seen end-on (round log ends with rings), stacked in a pyramid on two short bearers, with a tree stump chopping block beside it holding an axe.

assets.name: icons
assets.prompt: A sheet of 9 separate inventory item icons laid out on a 3 by 3 grid with generous magenta space between them, each icon the same size, front view: (row 1) a straw hat, a rolled paper scroll, a wooden hammer; (row 2) a wooden crate with an apple, an envelope letter with a red wax seal, a brass cog gear; (row 3) a gold coin, a smiling sun, a green leaf sprout. Each icon has its own dark outline.
